brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net a site where it finds my moots, finds all the accounts they block, outputs a list of all accounts with at least 6 blocks, from most to least, and i can save as a moderation list

title SixDegreesOfSeperation
note: Built SixDegreesOfSeperation: finds your moots, tallies every block they've made, lists accounts blocked by 6+ (adjustable), saves picks as a modlist. Spelled it your way. #NaNoFoMo
